heading: INT. NEON ARENA - MAIN STAGE - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NEON ARENA - MAIN STAGE - NIGHT
BOOM.
Lights slam on.
Ten thousand fans ROAR.
ANGLE ON a glowing stage, two gaming rigs, a giant screen counting down from ten.
Ava, 12, sits at the left rig, headset crooked, knuckles white.
Ten seconds, Dad. Ten.
units.name: AVA
paren: cracking her fingers, eyes locked on the screen

units.text: Her father Ray, 40s, crouches at her side with a water bottle and a sweat-soaked T-shirt.
Breathe, Ava. Breathe, kiddo. You've got this.
units.name: RAY
paren: handing her the bottle, jaw tight

units.text: BEEP.
BEEP.
BEEP.
CLOSE ON Ava's thumbs, hovering over the controller.
On the giant screen: GAME START.
Left flank! Left flank! Where's Grandpa?!
units.name: AVA

units.text: INSERT - PHONE SCREEN: "GRANDPA WALT CALLING."
Ray's phone BUZZES on the desk.
He swipes it open and props it against the monitor.
Is she winning? Tell me she's winning. I've got the whole bingo hall watching!
units.name: WALT

units.text: She's winning, Dad! She's down to the last round!
units.name: RAY

units.text: BACK TO SCENE.
On the right rig: the rival, a hooded STRANGER, face lit blue by the screen, fingers a blur.
Not today, little one.
units.name: STRANGER

units.text: KRAKOOM.
Sparks erupt across the big screen.
The crowd GASPS.
Dad, he's got the golden shield!
units.name: AVA

units.text: So take it from him!
units.name: RAY

units.text: I'm trying!
units.name: AVA

units.text: WE SEE the Stranger's screen mirror Ava's: two avatars, one mountain, one flag.
Ava! Remember what I taught you! Duck and weave!
units.name: WALT

units.text: It's a video game, Grandpa, not boxing!
units.name: AVA

units.text: WHAM.
The Stranger's avatar knocks hers back a step.
Nice one, kid. I'm Marcus, by the way. Marcus Bell. I played your dad back in the day.
units.name: STRANGER
paren: peeling off his hood, grinning, suddenly kind

units.text: Marcus?! You're THE Marcus?!
units.name: RAY

units.text: Yep. Still got the reflexes.
units.name: MARCUS

units.text: Dad! Don't talk to the enemy!
units.name: AVA

units.text: Sorry! Sorry, kiddo, focus!
units.name: RAY

units.text: CLOSE ON the countdown: 00:09.
Seven seconds! Go, go, GO!
units.name: WALT

units.text: CRASH.
The big screen explodes in light.
